prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: public architectural inspiration story sprite. Create ONE image containing EXACTLY THREE equal-height landscape photographs STACKED VERTICALLY, edge-to-edge, no gutters, no borders, no text, no logos, no people. Overall portrait format; each of the three panels is a wide landscape frame. Every panel shows EXACTLY THE SAME physical space from EXACTLY THE SAME fixed camera viewpoint, with identical windows, structure, proportions and setting. Top = initial empty/stripped condition, middle = construction work underway with partially installed materials, bottom = envisioned finished result. This is generated architectural inspiration, no actual project claims. Editorial architectural photography, realistic construction details, warm natural light, restrained timber/cream/sage palette, believable scale, not luxury fantasy. Preserve strict spatial continuity across all three panels. HOMES: A Kitchen to Gather In. A narrow rowhome kitchen seen from the doorway, a single centered rear window, original timber floor, U-shaped work surfaces planned around that window. Top: cleared old cabinetry, bare plaster wall surfaces, retained window and floor. Middle: same view with timber base cabinet carcasses being fitted, sink plumbing at window, unfinished backsplash and worktop. Bottom: finished warm timber cabinetry and pale durable worktop, cream tile backsplash, sink below the SAME window, small open shelves, useful clear prep space. Do not add or move doors or windows across panels. Output a single vertical three-panel image.
